description.value: The study examined brain activity and cue-induced desire during presentation of Internet video game stimuli in healthy male adults after a standardized 10-day period of game play.

value: we hypothesized that desire for Internet video games during cue presentation would activate similar brain regions to those that have been linked with craving for drugs or pathologic gambling.
